description_en: Queries the edition specifications for Anti-DDoS for DCDN
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo查询DCDN DDoS用户版本规格
name: DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo

BandwidthLimit.description_en: The bandwidth limit for a single instance

Edition.description_en:
The edition. Valid values:

poc: Proof of Concept (POC) Edition.
basic: Basic Edition.
insurance: Insurance Edition.
unlimited: Unlimited Edition.
port_enhancement: Special Port Enhancement Edition
Edition.description_zh:
版本。取值范围：
poc：poc版
basic：基础版。
insurance：保险版。
unlimited ：无忧版。
port_enhancement：特殊端口增强版

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether the Anti-DDoS service is enabled. Valid values:

on: The service is enabled.
off: The service is disabled
Enable.description_zh:
用户是否开启DDoS防护服务  。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

IsSpecialPort.description_en:
Indicates whether custom ports are supported. Valid values:

yes: Custom ports are supported.
no: Custom ports are not supported
IsSpecialPort.description_zh:
是否支持自定义端口。取值范围：
yes：支持。
no：不支持

ProtectedArea.description_en:
The protected region. Valid values:

global: Global.
chinese_mainland: the Chinese mainland.
global_excluding_the_chinese_mainland: Global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
ProtectedArea.description_zh:
防护地区。取值范围：
global：全球。
chinese_mainland：中国内地。
global_excluding_the_chinese_mainland：全球（不包含中国内地）

SpecInfos.description_en: The supported rule codes and the configurations of the rules
SpecInfos.description_zh: 支持的规则代码及规则的配置信息

items.description_en: The supported rule codes and the configurations of the rules
items.description_zh: 支持的规则代码及规则的配置信息

Config.description_en:
The configuration code for the rule. Valid values:

total_defense_num: the total number of mitigation sessions included in the edition.
consume_defense_num: the number of used mitigation sessions included in the edition.
max_domain_num: the maximum number of domain names that can be added.
emain_domain_num: the number of added domain names.
defence_package_num: the total number of mitigation sessions in purchased extra packages.
consume_defence_package_num: the number of used mitigation sessions from purchased extra packages
Config.description_zh:
版本规则对应的配置代码。取值范围：
total_defense_num：版本总防护次数。
consume_defense_num：已使用的版本防护次数 。
max_domain_num：接入域名限制数。
emain_domain_num：已接入域名数 。
defence_package_num：额外购买的总防护次数。
consume_defence_package_num：额外购买的已使用的防护次数

Expr.description_en: The configuration expression of the rule
Expr.description_zh: 版本规则对应的配置表达式

Value.description_en: The value of the configuration expression for the rule
Value.description_zh: 版本规则对应的配置表达式值

Rule.description_en:
The rule of the edition. Valid values:

version_defense_num: rules related to the number of mitigation sessions for the edition.
domain_num: rules related to the limit on the number of domain names.
defence_package_num: rules related to extra mitigation session packages
Rule.description_zh:
版本规则。取值范围：
version_defense_num：版本防护次数相关规则。
domain_num：域名数限制相关规则。
defence_package_num：额外防护次数包相关规则
